name: chaoxing-weixin-study-helper-native-host
description: Native Messaging host for Chaoxing Weixin study helper.

scripts.build:win:x64: npm run prepare:pkg && npx --yes @yao-pkg/pkg@latest build/host.cjs --targets node22-win-x64 --fallback-to-source --output dist/win-x64/chaoxing-weixin-native-host.exe
scripts.build:win:arm64: npm run prepare:pkg && npx --yes @yao-pkg/pkg@latest build/host.cjs --targets node22-win-arm64 --fallback-to-source --output dist/win-arm64/chaoxing-weixin-native-host.exe
scripts.build:macos:x64: npm run prepare:pkg && npx --yes @yao-pkg/pkg@latest build/host.cjs --targets node22-macos-x64 --fallback-to-source --output dist/macos-x64/chaoxing-weixin-native-host
scripts.build:macos:arm64: npm run prepare:pkg && npx --yes @yao-pkg/pkg@latest build/host.cjs --targets node22-macos-arm64 --fallback-to-source --output dist/macos-arm64/chaoxing-weixin-native-host
scripts.build:linux:x64: npm run prepare:pkg && npx --yes @yao-pkg/pkg@latest build/host.cjs --targets node22-linux-x64 --fallback-to-source --output dist/linux-x64/chaoxing-weixin-native-host
scripts.build:native: npm run build:win:x64 && npm run build:win:arm64 && npm run build:macos:x64 && npm run build:macos:arm64 && npm run build:linux:x64
